item.title: Yemi Alade Is Counting Cash and Serving Looks in “Alhaja” Video
item.description: Yemi Alade wears a gold-embroidered black abaya in her “Alhaja” music video. We love how Yemi Alade gives us something new to talk about with each music video. If she isn’t channelling a photographer who could give Don Jazzy a run for his money, she’s stepping into the shoes of an Alhaja who clearly has money to spend, and she’s having a great time doing it. In the official music video for “Alhaja”, a standout track from her latest album, It’s Yemi Alade , the Afropop star leans into rich cultural aesthetics, striking outfits and scenes that feel like a celebration of success. Directed by Clarence Peters , the video plays with neon lighting, atmospheric torchlight and a cast that knows how to make an entrance. Yemi Alade holds a stack of cash in a scene from her “Alhaja” music video. Yemi has a wardrobe change for every mood, too. In one scene, she appears in a traditional red outfit, complete with a structured headwrap and layers of coral beads. Then comes a black-and-gold embroidered abaya, paired with bold gold hand jewellery and ornate rings. She’s giving us an Alhaja who knows exactly what she’s worth, and the styling makes sure we don’t miss it. Yemi Alade holds a stack of cash in a scene from her “Alhaja” music video. The details around her are just as fun. Vintage cars set the scene, traditional drums bring in the cultural touches, and cast members count cash beneath warm lanterns. It all adds to the video’s celebration of identity, prosperity and personal achievement, with Yemi right at the centre of it. With “Alhaja”, Yemi Alade gives us another music video with a distinct visual world, memorable styling and plenty of personality. And really, would we expect anything less? Watch the video below The post Yemi Alade Is Counting Cash and Serving Looks in “Alhaja” Video appeared first on BellaNaija - Showcasing Africa to the world. Read today! .

item.title: 82-yr-old US senator charged with drug trafficking, money laundering
item.description: An 82-year-old Democratic state senator in Virginia, L. Louise Lucas, has been indicted alongside six others, including members of her family, over an alleged racketeering conspiracy involving the illegal sale of marijuana and money laundering. According to the indictment, Lucas, president pro tempore of Virginia’s Senate, allegedly operated several businesses that bought and sold illegal quantities of marijuana in the state to build her family’s wealth. The indictment also accuses her of using her political influence to protect the alleged operation from criminal scrutiny and influence legislation for financial gain. In a statement on the charges, FBI Director Kash Patel alleged that Lucas worked with “a close-knit group of family members and associates” to build a “criminal marijuana enterprise”. Patel further accused the senator of using her “position as Chairwoman of the Senate Finance and Appropriations Committee to insulate the enterprise from criminal scrutiny and influencing legislation to financially benefit themselves.” Lucas faces charges including racketeering conspiracy, conspiracy to possess and distribute marijuana, and conspiracy to launder money. A Justice Department spokesperson confirmed that she had surrendered to law enforcement. Responding to the indictment on Thursday, Lucas criticised the federal government’s actions against her. “Today, the FBI, the Department of Justice, and the full weight of the federal government have been wielded against an 82-year-old great-grandmother,” Lucas said in a statement. “I grew up under Jim Crow. I’ve seen what happens when people in power try to silence those who stand up to them. I spent my life fighting back, and I’m not stopping now.” Lucas has long advocated for the legalisation of marijuana in Virginia, including through legislative efforts. However, prosecutors allege that she and her co-conspirators spent years selling and maintaining illegal quantities of the drug through various businesses and shops. Virginia recently passed a law permitting regulated retail marijuana sales from July 1, 2027. The indictment comes weeks before Election Day, although Lucas is not seeking re-election this year. Her daughter, Lisa Lucas-Burke, who was also charged in the case, is running for City Council in Portsmouth, Virginia. Virginia Democratic Governor Abigail Spanberger said she had reviewed the charging document and maintained that Lucas and her family should be allowed to defend themselves against the allegations. “They deserve the opportunity to present their defense and speak to the allegations presented,” Spanberger said. She also criticised the timing of the indictment, arguing that it could undermine public confidence in the Justice Department. “The timing of this indictment undermines the U.S. Department of Justice’s previously longstanding policy of not taking legal actions — to include indictments or significant investigative steps — close to an election and sadly, this timing furthe
item.dc:creator: efosataiwo@vanguardngr.com
item.content:encoded: An 82-year-old Democratic state senator in Virginia, L. Louise Lucas, has been indicted alongside six others, including members of her family, over an alleged racketeering conspiracy involving the illegal sale of marijuana and money laundering. According to the indictment, Lucas, president pro tempore of Virginia’s Senate, allegedly operated several businesses that bought and sold illegal quantities of marijuana in the state to build her family’s wealth. The indictment also accuses her of using her political influence to protect the alleged operation from criminal scrutiny and influence legislation for financial gain. In a statement on the charges, FBI Director Kash Patel alleged that Lucas worked with “a close-knit group of family members and associates” to build a “criminal marijuana enterprise”. Patel further accused the senator of using her “position as Chairwoman of the Senate Finance and Appropriations Committee to insulate the enterprise from criminal scrutiny and influencing legislation to financially benefit themselves.” Lucas faces charges including racketeering conspiracy, conspiracy to possess and distribute marijuana, and conspiracy to launder money. A Justice Department spokesperson confirmed that she had surrendered to law enforcement. Responding to the indictment on Thursday, Lucas criticised the federal government’s actions against her. “Today, the FBI, the Department of Justice, and the full weight of the federal government have been wielded against an 82-year-old great-grandmother,” Lucas said in a statement. “I grew up under Jim Crow. I’ve seen what happens when people in power try to silence those who stand up to them. I spent my life fighting back, and I’m not stopping now.” Lucas has long advocated for the legalisation of marijuana in Virginia, including through legislative efforts. However, prosecutors allege that she and her co-conspirators spent years selling and maintaining illegal quantities of the drug through various businesses and shops. Virginia recently passed a law permitting regulated retail marijuana sales from July 1, 2027. The indictment comes weeks before Election Day, although Lucas is not seeking re-election this year. Her daughter, Lisa Lucas-Burke, who was also charged in the case, is running for City Council in Portsmouth, Virginia. Virginia Democratic Governor Abigail Spanberger said she had reviewed the charging document and maintained that Lucas and her family should be allowed to defend themselves against the allegations. “They deserve the opportunity to present their defense and speak to the allegations presented,” Spanberger said. She also criticised the timing of the indictment, arguing that it could undermine public confidence in the Justice Department. “The timing of this indictment undermines the U.S. Department of Justice’s previously longstanding policy of not taking legal actions — to include indictments or significant investigative steps — close to an election and sadly, this timing further erodes the trust the American people deserve to have in the Department of Justice,” Spanberger said. Earlier this year, FBI agents executed search warrants at two of Lucas’s marijuana shops as part of an investigation that began under former President Joe Biden. According to the indictment, investigators recovered marijuana and firearms from both locations. Lucas, who was elected to the Virginia State Senate in 1991, is also accused of paying $750,000 for a 100 per cent stake in a shell holding company that prosecutors allege was established to help a co-conspirator obtain a state licence to sell marijuana. Prosecutors further allege that Lucas subsequently received what the Justice Department described as a “bribery payment” from the co-conspirator in connection with her efforts. The department also alleged that Lucas “failed to report the interest obtained in this entity on her required Statement of Economic Interests forms” as a legislator. In a statement announcing the charges, the Justice Department alleged that Lucas met with the co-conspirator at her office in the Capitol complex to receive a partial repayment. “Lucas allegedly met with the co-conspirator at her office at the capitol complex to receive a partial repayment and spoke with other officials, including legislators, about the co-conspirator’s qualification for a recreational marijuana license depending on her receipt of a bribery payment from the co-conspirator,” the department said. Investigators also alleged that Lucas spoke with an unidentified co-conspirator by phone in February about obtaining a recreational marijuana licence and sharing the proceeds. “This is our last chance at generational wealth,” investigators quoted Lucas as telling the co-conspirator. “I’ve got too old to not be greedy.” Vanguard News The post 82-yr-old US senator charged with drug trafficking, money laundering appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Which chapter should you choose first in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4?
item.description: Once you've completed the tutorial and the first page of orders, you'll be asked to choose one of three DMZ chapters in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . The game tells you that the ones you don't choose will be available to you later on, so you're not locked out of them entirely, but it does mean you should prioritize the chapter that will offer you the best rewards.

item.title: TUC not part of FG talks, issued no ultimatum, NLC clarifies
item.description: By Victor Ahiuma-Young The Nigeria Labour Congress, NLC, has clarified that the Trade Union Congress of Nigeria, TUC, neither issued an ultimatum to the Federal Government nor participated in the dialogue between the government and the NLC held on October 22, 2026. The clarification follows media reports that mentioned the TUC in connection with the ultimatum and the meeting, prompting the NLC to set the record straight and absolve the sister labour centre of any involvement in the specific engagement. In a statement signed by its Acting General Secretary, Comrade Benson Upah, the NLC said the TUC’s name was erroneously included in some newspaper reports, while acknowledging that a greater number of publications correctly attributed the statement to the NLC alone. The statement reads: “The Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) wishes to clarify that the Trade Union Congress (TUC) did not issue an ultimatum to the government and was not part of the dialogue between the NLC and Federal Government yesterday, 22nd October 2026 even as the TUC side of Joint Health Workers Union of Nigeria, JOHESU and Joint Public Service Negotiating Council, JPSNC were represented at the dialogue. “TUC’s name featured in error in a paper or two but we note that a greater number of the papers appropriately attributed the statement to NLC only. “This is to categorically state that only the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) was present at the meeting. “The TUC is completely exonerated from the purports of this specific dialogue. We urge the public and media to take note of this correction, please.” The post TUC not part of FG talks, issued no ultimatum, NLC clarifies appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: WTC 2027 Final: Qualification scenarios, chances and probabilities for World Test Championship final
item.description: WTC 2027 Final: Qualification scenarios, chances and probabilities for World Test Championship final originally appeared on Cricket News . Add Cricket News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . KEY TAKEAWAYS: The Oval will host the 2027 WTC final from June 9 to June 13. Australia lead the table at 75%, with New Zealand and South Africa chasing hard. India sit fifth on 51.52% and need near-perfect results from their seven remaining Tests. World Test Championship 2025–2027 Final Qualification: Scenarios for India, New Zealand, Australia and South Africa With less than a year left before the next World Test Championship final, nine teams are still in the race for two places at The Oval, and the table is starting to separate the contenders from the rest. Australia hold the top spot, South Africa have found form again after their win in Gqeberha, and India are now fighting an uphill battle. The Oval has been confirmed as the venue, and the match will be played from Wednesday, June 9 to Sunday, June 13. The ICC announced last year that England had won the hosting rights for the next three finals, in 2027, 2029 and 2031, and the England and Wales Cricket Board picks the ground for each edition. This will be the second time The Oval stages the showpiece, after Australia beat India there in 2023 to lift the mace. The first three editions have each produced a different champion. New Zealand won the inaugural title in 2021, Australia took the mace in 2023, and South Africa ended their long wait for a major ICC trophy in 2025. Latest World Test Championship points table 2027: Australia, New Zealand and South Africa lead Points are awarded on a simple scale, with 12 for a win, six for a tie, four for a draw and none for a loss, and slow over-rate penalties can reduce a team’s total. Pos Team Matches Wins Losses Ties Draws No result Points PCT 1 Australia 12 9 3 0 0 0 108 75.00 2 New Zealand 6 4 1 0 1 0 52 72.22 3 South Africa 6 4 2 0 1 0 48 66.67 4 Bangladesh 6 3 2 0 1 0 40 55.56 5 India 11 5 4 0 2 0 68 51.52 6 England 16 7 8 0 1 0 74 34.44 7 Sri Lanka 6 1 2 0 3 0 24 33.33 8 West Indies 12 2 8 2 2 0 30 20.83 9 Pakistan 9 2 7 0 0 6 16 16.67 WTC final qualification chances: Australia, India, New Zealand and South Africa After their latest victory in Gqeberha, South Africa on top, with a 79% chance of qualifying, which is up 18 points. Australia follow at 74%, down 11, and New Zealand are at 41%, down six. India and Bangladesh each stand at 3%, Sri Lanka at 0.2% and England at 0.1%, while West Indies and Pakistan are out of the race. The “wins needed” column shows how many victories each side requires to reach the likely cutoff by the end of the league stage. Australia lead the table at 75%, with New Zealand and South Africa chasing hard. India sit fifth on 51.52% and need near-perfect results from their seven remaining Tests. World Test Championship 2025–2027 Final Qualification: Scenarios for India, New Zealand, Australia and South Africa With less than a year left before the next World Test Championship final, nine teams are still in the race for two places at The Oval, and the table is starting to separate the contenders from the rest. Australia hold the top spot, South Africa have found form again after their win in Gqeberha, and India are now fighting an uphill battle. The Oval has been confirmed as the venue, and the match will be played from Wednesday, June 9 to Sunday, June 13. The ICC announced last year that England had won the hosting rights for the next three finals, in 2027, 2029 and 2031, and the England and Wales Cricket Board picks the ground for each edition. This will be the second time The Oval stages the showpiece, after Australia beat India there in 2023 to lift the mace. The first three editions have each produced a different champion. New Zealand won the inaugural title in 2021, Australia took the mace in 2023, and South Africa ended their long wait for a major ICC trophy in 2025. Latest World Test Championship points table 2027: Australia, New Zealand and South Africa lead Points are awarded on a simple scale, with 12 for a win, six for a tie, four for a draw and none for a loss, and slow over-rate penalties can reduce a team’s total. Pos Team Matches Wins Losses Ties Draws No result Points PCT 1 Australia 12 9 3 0 0 0 108 75.00 2 New Zealand 6 4 1 0 1 0 52 72.22 3 South Africa 6 4 2 0 1 0 48 66.67 4 Bangladesh 6 3 2 0 1 0 40 55.56 5 India 11 5 4 0 2 0 68 51.52 6 England 16 7 8 0 1 0 74 34.44 7 Sri Lanka 6 1 2 0 3 0 24 33.33 8 West Indies 12 2 8 2 2 0 30 20.83 9 Pakistan 9 2 7 0 0 6 16 16.67 WTC final qualification chances: Australia, India, New Zealand and South Africa After their latest victory in Gqeberha, South Africa on top, with a 79% chance of qualifying, which is up 18 points. Australia follow at 74%, down 11, and New Zealand are at 41%, down six. India and Bangladesh each stand at 3%, Sri Lanka at 0.2% and England at 0.1%, while West Indies and Pakistan are out of the race. The “wins needed” column shows how many victories each side requires to reach the likely cutoff by the end of the league stage. Team Qualification chance Fixtures remaining Wins needed South Africa 79% (up 18) Home: Australia (1), Bangladesh (2), England (3); Away: Sri Lanka (2) 5 of 8 Australia 74% (down 11) Home: New Zealand (4); Away: South Africa (1), India (5) 6 of 10 New Zealand 41% (down 6) Home: India (2), Sri Lanka (2); Away: Australia (4), Pakistan (2) 7 of 10 India 3% Home: Australia (5); Away: New Zealand (2) 6 of 7 Bangladesh 3% Home: West Indies (2), England (2); Away: South Africa (2) 5 of 6 Sri Lanka 0.2% Home: South Africa (2); Away: Pakistan (2), New Zealand (2) 6 of 6 England 0.1% Away: South Africa (3), Bangladesh (2) - West Indies Out Away: Bangladesh (2) - Pakistan Out Home: Sri Lanka (2), New Zealand (2) - Australia’s path to the WTC final: Cape Town and the Border-Gavaskar Trophy Australia are the top contender, with a points percentage of 75.00. Their remaining fixtures include the third Test against South Africa in Cape Town, afour-match Test series against New Zealand, followed by the five-Test Border-Gavaskar Trophy in India in early 2027. They need roughly three wins from their remaining 10 Tests to cross the 65% mark, and even a split of results across Cape Town and India should keep Pat Cummins’ side in the top two. South Africa’s WTC final chances after the Gqeberha win South Africa stand on 66.67%, and their innings win in Gqeberha has kept the defending champions well within reach of the final. If Temba Bavuma’s team win the decider in Cape Town and then dominate their series against Bangladesh and Sri Lanka, they could finish above 68%, which would put heavy pressure on New Zealand and India. New Zealand’s WTC final path: why home wins are essential New Zealand are on 72.22%, and they have played only six matches, so they hold a strong base. Their coming schedule is demanding, with a two-Test home series against India in late November, followed by a trip to Australia. Winning at home is a must if they want to hold off South Africa. India’s WTC final qualification scenario: the maths for Gill’s side India are fifth with 51.52% after a draw in Colombo and lost points earlier in the cycle. They have seven Tests left, worth 84 points, and they must win at least five and draw one, or win six, to reach a safe mark of around 64%. They cannot afford more than one defeat across the New Zealand tour and the home series against Australia combined. A clean sweep or a 4-1 win over Australia at home, along with at least one victory in New Zealand, remains the ideal route to The Oval. Why India’s WTC final hopes depend on the New Zealand tour India’s position is difficult, but it is not hopeless, and the next five weeks may decide how realistic it is. The New Zealand series comes before the Australia home series, so a poor result there would leave almost no margin for error. Even a single defeat would put the 64% target at risk, which is a harsh mathematical reality for a team that has lost ground through draws. The home series is more promising on paper, since the venues suit India’s spinners and Australia have historically struggled in those conditions. A big win there, however, will not mean much if the New Zealand games are lost, and the pitches in Wellington and Christchurch could test a batting line-up that has not always travelled well. The projections give India only a 3% chance, which seems low, but the figure reflects how few wins they can afford to drop. The approach should be to look at it one Test at a time, and a strong start in New Zealand would change the tone of the whole season. item.title: Carrick ‘100%’ sure he can lead United forward; Dortmund take on the influencers: football – live
item.description: ⚽ All the latest news going into the weekend’s action ⚽ Premier League: weekend guide | Mail Tom Álvaro Arbeloa’s been talking ahead of Fulham’s trip to Coventry on Saturday, and buoyed up by last weekend’s much needed win over Hull. “Nothing has changed for us,” insisted the manager, “we were not winning games but we believed in ourselves, we were doing so many things well, “The most important thing [about the Hull win] is we were in same situation against Manchester United and Ipswich but didn’t win but now we had to improve in our transition and did. We controlled the ball in their half better than before.” As the Messi-Ronaldo rivalry faded, though, so too did the clásico ’s relevance. This isn’t to say matches between Barcelona and Real Madrid no longer matter. They always have and always will. In 2026, however, it’s difficult to measure a clásico ’s standing. Is it still the sport’s biggest fixture? Sunday’s match at Camp Nou will be watched by hundreds of millions of viewers all over the world. A clásico always carries significance, but this weekend’s edition will be especially significant. A Barça win would move them nine points clear of their rivals at the top of La Liga . A Real Madrid victory could be a catalyst for the rest of their season. Continue reading...

item.title: Real Madrid legend’s son continues to take major strides towards first-team breakthrough at club
item.description: Real Madrid legend’s son continues to take major strides towards first-team breakthrough at club Real Madrid youngster Enzo Alves is rapidly building a reputation of his own, with AS reporting that the son of club legend Marcelo is attracting attention across Europe after an impressive rise through the academy. The outlet mentions that the 17-year-old striker has scored more than 150 goals in a Real Madrid shirt and continues to strengthen his case as one of the club’s most promising young attacking talents. His latest statement came against RB Leipzig in the UEFA Youth League on October 21, when he opened the scoring in Real Madrid’s 5-2 victory. His composed finish in the 15th minute helped the reigning champions secure a third consecutive win in the competition. Enzo Alves beginning to step out of Marcelo’s shadow Comparisons with a famous parent are inevitable in sport, but Enzo is increasingly giving everyone reasons to assess him on his own merits. While Marcelo made his name as an attack-minded left-back, his son is developing as a forward, using his movement and instincts in the penalty area to influence matches. His progress at Valdebebas has gathered momentum throughout 2026. After making his UEFA Youth League debut in November 2025, Enzo has continued to climb the academy ladder, earning opportunities at higher levels and attracting growing attention for his goalscoring. Real Madrid’s trust in his potential was explained in January, when he signed his first professional contract with the club. The agreement followed a period of progress that had already seen him train and play across different youth levels, with the club keen to retain a talent it considers valuable for the future. Real Madrid have high hopes for their academy striker Enzo Alves is gaining attention at Real Madrid. (Photo by Ben Roberts Photo/Getty Images) It is to be remembered that Alvaro Arbeloa previously gave him a chance with Castilla before moving into the senior coaching structure, providing the youngster with experience at a higher competitive level. His route to the first team, however, remains a long-term ambition rather than an immediate guarantee. The next major test could come internationally. The FIFA Under-17 World Cup is scheduled to take place in Qatar from November 19 to December 13, 2026, and Enzo is tipped for involvement with Spain’s youth setup. Indeed, Enzo still has significant work ahead, but his goals, recent Youth League performance and new professional contract show that his progress is being taken seriously.

item.title: Packers’ Matt LaFleur gushes about Jahmyr Gibbs’ ‘elite’ skillset before Lions clash
item.description: Lon Horwedel-Imagn Images Packers’ Matt LaFleur gushes about Jahmyr Gibbs’ ‘elite’ skillset before Lions clash appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Green Bay Packers are looking confident heading into Week 7 . Green Bay is 4-2 on the season and riding a three-game winning streak after struggling to start the year. However, the Packers will not be overconfident when facing an NFC North rival on Sunday . Packers head coach Matt LaFleur is not going to underestimate Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs in Week 7. He gushed about Gibbs’ elite abilities ahead of this weekend’s matchup. “You cannot relax for one second with this guy. … He has elite change of direction skills,” LaFleur said about Gibbs on Thursday, per ESPN’s Rob Demovsky. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) LaFleur added that Gibbs could probably play slot receiver if Detroit asked him to. The Packers would be wise to focus on shutting down Gibbs, who is by far the most explosive player on Detroit’s offense. Gibbs has 105 carries for 504 rushing yards and seven touchdowns through five games this year. That is on top of 27 receptions for 243 receiving yards and two touchdowns through the air. The Lions run a large chunk of their offense through the speedy running back. Once Gibbs establishes himself in a game, Detroit’s entire offense opens up. If the Packers do not put a lid on Gibbs’ production, they could be in for a real shootout. Fortunately, the Packers looked equipped to go toe to toe with the Lions. Green Bay’s defense has been playing well recently, even with Micah Parsons still on the sideline. They should also get Josh Jacobs back this week , which could improve Green Bay’s terrible rushing attack. If the Packers can control the clock with their running game, they can suck the air out of the ball. As a result, they can slow down Gibbs by simply keeping him off the field entirely. It will be exciting to see who comes out on top of this huge NFC North showdown on Sunday. Packers at Lions kicks off at 4:25 p.m. ET on Oct. 25 from Ford Field in Detroit. Related: Packers’ Matt LaFleur eases concerns about Christian Watson, Matthew Golden despite injuries Related: Packers’ perfect Saquon Barkley trade offer to Eagles before NFL trade deadline

item.title: Who is supporting Gianni Infantino and how many votes will secure re-election as Fifa president?
item.description: Gianni Infantino is facing a battle to cling onto his Fifa presidency heading into next year’s election after his botched bid to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors resulted in a significant loss in support. England and Wales have been among the football associations to join European governing body Uefa in leading the charge for Infantino’s removal from power, formally withdrawing their endorsement of the Swiss-Italian for re-election in March 2027 . But as the dust has settled on his privatisation ploy, Infantino’s bid for a third term has strengthened. His allies have surfaced, with the likes of Mexico and Argentina joining Caf , the African football governing body, in reaffirming support for the under-fire president, and now the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has reversed its position and backed Infantino with AFC president Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa underlining that there is “a true understanding between us”. Infantino needs 106 votes from the 211 member associations to be re-elected as president . Here is every country and confederation to have expressed their opposition or support for Infantino: Who has formally withdrawn its support for Infantino? Uefa (55 members) 🇪🇺 Uefa, the governing body for Europe, has staunchly opposed Infantino’s leadership. They threatened a boycott of Fifa competitions before Infantino’s eventual climbdown but has continued to assert that his position is untenable, even taking legal action against the Swiss-Italian. The body points to how there have not been “assurances” that attempts like the privatisation of the World Cup “to disfigure the game in this way will never be made again”. More recently, Uefa general secretary Theodore Theodoridis has written to his Fifa counterpart Mattias Grafstrom setting out a series of questions on behalf of European members of the Fifa Council, demanding documents covering a series of Infantino controversies. Fifa has until 2 November to answer these questions. Concacaf (41 members) 🌎 Concacaf, the Confederation for North America and the Caribbean, came out in opposition of Infantino after being left stunned at the lack of consultation during the Fifa sell-off plan, which they went on to reject. After the plan was aborted, the confederation said: “This recent unilateral and egregious act of poor governance and leadership follows a pattern of missteps and similar behaviour. A comprehensive reckoning with this presidency is imperative.” Concacaf president Victor Montagliani was initially seen as a front-runner to challenge Infantino in next March’s election but he now looks set to pursue another term as Concacaf chief. item.content:encoded: Gianni Infantino is facing a battle to cling onto his Fifa presidency heading into next year’s election after his botched bid to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors resulted in a significant loss in support. England and Wales have been among the football associations to join European governing body Uefa in leading the charge for Infantino’s removal from power, formally withdrawing their endorsement of the Swiss-Italian for re-election in March 2027 . But as the dust has settled on his privatisation ploy, Infantino’s bid for a third term has strengthened. His allies have surfaced, with the likes of Mexico and Argentina joining Caf , the African football governing body, in reaffirming support for the under-fire president, and now the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has reversed its position and backed Infantino with AFC president Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa underlining that there is “a true understanding between us”. Infantino needs 106 votes from the 211 member associations to be re-elected as president . Here is every country and confederation to have expressed their opposition or support for Infantino: Who has formally withdrawn its support for Infantino? Uefa (55 members) 🇪🇺 Uefa, the governing body for Europe, has staunchly opposed Infantino’s leadership. They threatened a boycott of Fifa competitions before Infantino’s eventual climbdown but has continued to assert that his position is untenable, even taking legal action against the Swiss-Italian. The body points to how there have not been “assurances” that attempts like the privatisation of the World Cup “to disfigure the game in this way will never be made again”. More recently, Uefa general secretary Theodore Theodoridis has written to his Fifa counterpart Mattias Grafstrom setting out a series of questions on behalf of European members of the Fifa Council, demanding documents covering a series of Infantino controversies. Fifa has until 2 November to answer these questions. Concacaf (41 members) 🌎 Concacaf, the Confederation for North America and the Caribbean, came out in opposition of Infantino after being left stunned at the lack of consultation during the Fifa sell-off plan, which they went on to reject. After the plan was aborted, the confederation said: “This recent unilateral and egregious act of poor governance and leadership follows a pattern of missteps and similar behaviour. A comprehensive reckoning with this presidency is imperative.” Concacaf president Victor Montagliani was initially seen as a front-runner to challenge Infantino in next March’s election but he now looks set to pursue another term as Concacaf chief. England 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 The English FA are one of many European member associations to send a letter to Fifa withdrawing its support for Infantino’s re-election in 2027. Infantino’s apology letter that was sent around on Wednesday night changed nothing for the FA, who was “deeply concerned about the lack of process and governance” surrounding his sell-off scheme. FA chief executive Mark Bullingham (left) next to Gianni Infantino (PA) Wales 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 The Football Association of Wales were one of the first to send its letter withdrawing support for Infantino . “The ‌recent failures in good governance, processes, ‌leadership, values, stakeholder management, communications and sound judgment ​have led us to a position ‌where Mr Infantino has lost the confidence of the FAW to ‌remain at the helm of world football,” a statement read. “Failing to put the best interests of football first is a failure we cannot accept.” Scotland 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 The SFA’s chief executive Ian Maxwell told the BBC that the governing body’s position has “been clear” since Uefa’s collective statement. “We have aligned ourselves with the Uefa position and 55 nations are stronger than one voice. “Their statement since then has talked about a lack of confidence in the Fifa leadership and the Scottish FA agree completely with that decision. “The SFA will not be voting for Gianni Infantino come the re-election in early 2027.” Republic of Ireland 🇮🇪 The Football Association of Ireland (FAI) has followed in withdrawing its support for Infantino while backing Uefa’s stance. "Following an FAI board meeting, the decision was taken to rescind the letter of support that the Association supplied earlier this year," it confirmed. "It has since written to Fifa to explain its reasoning. The Association is grateful for the support that Fifa provides to Irish football, but recent events have raised significant concerns regarding governance, transparency and the lack of meaningful consultation.” Italy 🇮🇹 The Italian Football Federation (FIGC) took a few weeks to take official action but it has now withdrawn its support for Infantino's candidacy in the next Fifa presidential election scheduled. "This decision is intended to clearly and transparently express the FIGC's position - in full agreement with Uefa and its president Aleksander Ceferin - regarding the recent initiatives promoted by the FIFA president concerning the governance and development of international competitions," FIGC said in a statement. Finland 🇫🇮 Finland kickstarted this process of formal withdrawals, with it being revealed that the Scandinavian member association was the first to send a letter officially withdrawing support for Infantino. Serbia 🇷🇸 The Football Association of Serbia then sent a similar letter to Fifa. “We would like to remind you that we provided our support to Mr Infantino in writing on 25 May of this year, but after carefully considering the events that have seriously damaged the image and reputation of both Fifa and its president in the past period, this is the only logical and rational course of action,” a statement read. Sweden 🇸🇪 Sweden’s federation (SvFF) followed suit: "At an extraordinary board meeting on Monday, SvFF has chosen not to support Fifa President Gianni Infantino ​in the upcoming re-election. "This is after a long-term assessment of the development within Fifa and the organization's leadership. The decision is based on recurring shortcomings in governance, transparency and management, which means that trust in Gianni Infantino's leadership no longer exists." Infantino has officially lost the endorsement of numerous Uefa nations (PA) Croatia 🇭🇷 As did the Croatian Football Federation (HNS): "The Croatian Football Federation has informed Fifa of its decision to withdraw the support previously expressed for Mr Gianni Infantino's candidature for another term as Fifa president. "This decision followed a thorough reassessment within the federation in light of recent developments surrounding the Fifa World Cup 2026 and discussions within our governing bodies. We consider our position to be clearly communicated to Fifa and have no further comment to add at this time." Albania 🇦🇱 The Albanian Football Federation also took the same stance, aligning with Uefa. “The Albanian Football Association has sent an official letter to Fifa Secretary General Mattias Grafström, informing him that it has withdrawn its support for Mr Gianni Infantino’s candidacy for another four-year term as Fifa President,” the statement confirmed. Greece 🇬🇷 The Greek Football Association has backed Uefa’s push for a change in Fifa’s leadership, similarly withdrawing support to underscore a united European front in opposition to Infantino. "The Greek FA (EPO) has taken a clear position against a candidacy of Gianni Infantino," EPO presdient Makis Gagatsis told reporters. "We saw things happen at the World Cup that are not acceptable to football public opinion. Then... came a programme to sell World Cup rights and we are clearly against it, so we withdrew our support of the Fifa president." item.title: Brian Branch's return doesn't spell end for Keith Abney II at safety
item.description: ALLEN PARK — Brian Branch is back. That's obviously great news for the Detroit Lions , who desperately need help on the back end of a defense that's allowed 23 receptions of at least 20 yards this season, tied with the New England Patriots for the third most in the league, behind the Buffalo Bills (26) and Houston Texans (24). That's despite the Lions (3-2) playing one fewer game than the Bills (5-1) and Texans (2-4), and two fewer than the Patriots (4-3). But what does Branch's return mean for someone like Keith Abney II, the rookie defensive back who starred on the outside at Arizona State, was drafted to play in the slot but then stepped in at safety in Detroit's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals ? It sounds like the Lions remain interested in his future at the position. " Abney is worth continuing to invest in," Lions coach Dan Campbell said earlier this week as the team prepares to host the Green Bay Packers at Ford Field on Sunday, Oct. 25. "I mean, he's going to play for us." Playing safety for the first time since he was in middle school , Abney finished with six tackles, a pass deflection and an interception across 59 defensive snaps against the Cardinals . Most of Abney's reps came with him lined up in the deep portion of the field, tasked with protecting the Lions from being hit over the top. Abney played his role well. That's one thing against the Cardinals, who have struggled to produce explosive passes more than just about every other team in the NFL. It's a whole other challenge versus a group like the Packers, who have been launching passes down the field to Christian Watson and Matthew Golden; among the 105 wide receivers with at least 15 receptions this season, Watson (18.6) and Golden (16.7) rank third and fifth, respectively, in average yards per catch. Still, what Abney put on tape in Week 5 has the Lions intrigued. "When you're the roof of the defense, things can go really bad when that player makes a mistake," defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard said Thursday, Oct. 22. "And that's something he's consistently done (not make a mistake). I stood up here and told you guys, dating through training camp, he was one of the smartest rookies I've ever been around." Asked who'll lose snaps at safety to create opportunities for Branch, Campbell indicated both Abney and veteran Chuck Clark, the latter of whom has started every game for the Lions this season, would remain as contributors. That's the beauty of Branch, who's incredibly versatile, capable of playing deep as a free safety or in the box as a strong safety. He can also play in the slot. "We're going to use all those guys," Campbell said. Abney, who grew up a fan of Branch's alma mater (Alabama), didn't anticipate sliding in the draft as far as he did — he was chosen 157th overall — nor did he expect to be playing safety this early into his career. item.title: ‘Classy’ – Skip Bayless gives his take on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander’s 20-point streak ending
item.description: Photo by Kenneth Richmond/Getty Images Shai Gilgeous-Alexander’s 20-point scoring streak came to an end on Thursday when the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Denver Nuggets. The Thunder are now 2-0 after picking up a 96-84 victory but the main talking point coming out of the game has not been the result. Instead, it has centred on Gilgeous-Alexander failing to score 20 points or more in a regular season game for the first time in nearly two years. He scored 17 on the night before subbing himself out of the game, which Skip Bayless has now reacted to and called a ‘classy move’. Speaking in a video shared on X/Twitter, he said: “What a great, classy move by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. For 126 straight games, he had scored at least 20 points. “It’s the most unbelievable record in sports. I believe it will never, ever be broken. It was 15 more games than Wilt Chamberlain had in 63/64. I so appreciated the way it ended because Shai, with a minute and 43 seconds left, had 17 points and had heated up in the fourth quarter with 11 points and I’m thinking, ‘He’s going to do it again’. “The Thunder were up 17 and the Nuggets took all their starters out and just gave up and Shai just marched straight to the bench and say ‘no, that’s enough, I struggled all night’. He was pretty terrible for most of the night by his standards, didn’t score a bucket in the first half, 0-7. “Denver always does a good to great job on him, and they did a great job tonight. They really make him work. I think he demonstrated, ‘I could still get this if I wanted it,’ and this is just me, I think he wanted Denver to break the record. He appreciates and respects how they play him defensively.” The Thunder will now return to the court on Sunday against the LA Clippers, who are 1-0 ahead of their next game versus the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday. item.title: Fantasy Football Week 7: Studs, Duds And Could-Be With Stats
item.description: DETROIT, MICHIGAN - DECEMBER 05: Jahmyr Gibbs #26 of the Detroit Lions scores a touchdown against the Green Bay Packers(Photo by Nic Antaya/Getty Images) Getty Images Goodness gracious, the chaos and carnage are in full force, and we haven’t even hit the halfway mark in fantasy football yet! Get well soon, Terry McLaurin, Davante Adams, and Jalen Hurts (to name just a few). And how are your fantasy rosters holding up? Hang in there; let’s navigate this carnage and move on to Week 7 of the NFL 2026 season. For Week 7, you will be missing the services of quarterbacks Josh Allen, Trevor Lawrence, and Jayden Daniels. Parker Washington, James Cook, and anyone you may have had to roster from the Los Angeles Chargers and Washington Commanders are also not available. So note, there are four teams on a bye this week. The International game will be the Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints; get the studs from that game out of your flex. And remember the “stud” designation refers to fantasypros.com , top-10 fantasy leaders in points. For Week 7, that will be those who led from Weeks1-6. Let’s do this. Pittsburgh Steelers -3.5 v New Orleans Saints, 44.5 This is an International game, being played in Paris, France. Studs: WR4 Chris Olave, TE7 Juwan Johnson, TE8 Pat Friermuth, DST3 Pittsburgh Steelers, LB4 Payton Wilson , DB6 Jalen Ramsey Dud: QB Tyler Shough Could-Be: RB Jaylen Warren PITTSBURGH, PENNSYLVANIA - OCTOBER 11: Jaylen Warren #30 of the Pittsburgh Steelers rushes for a 50 yard touchdown during the third quarter against the Indianapolis Colts(Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images) Getty Images The Why: International games are like divisional games; they are hard to predict. But we know this: Shough is playing with two broken bones in his left hand, and while he is first in pass attempts per game (41.2) and the team is second in pass plays per game (45), last week against the New York Giants (he did have three touchdown passes), he threw for 144 yards; the week prior against the Minnesota Vikings (he did have two interceptions and zero touchdown passes), he threw for 96 yards. This week, he gets the Steelers, who allow the fourth-fewest fantasy points per game to quarterbacks (11.7) and have six interceptions in six weeks while allowing only six touchdown passes. Warren is a beast. While Tampa Bay held him to 50 rushing yards last week, he has a 76.8% opportunity share, a 15.4% target share, and a 57.5% route participation. He averages 5.9 yards per carry and leads the league in yards per touch, at 7.2 per game. And now he will come up against a Saints defense that is allowing the third-most rushing yards per game (138) and the most fantasy points to the running back position (25.7), with 11 rushing touchdowns allowed in six games. Indianapolis Colts @ Minnesota Vikings -6.5, 41.5 The Vikings are coming off their bye week; the Colts are coming off a 20-26 home loss to the Tennessee Titans. Studs: RB5 Jonathan Taylor, DST1 Minnesota Vikings, DL7 DeFo
item.content:encoded: DETROIT, MICHIGAN - DECEMBER 05: Jahmyr Gibbs #26 of the Detroit Lions scores a touchdown against the Green Bay Packers(Photo by Nic Antaya/Getty Images) Getty Images Goodness gracious, the chaos and carnage are in full force, and we haven’t even hit the halfway mark in fantasy football yet! Get well soon, Terry McLaurin, Davante Adams, and Jalen Hurts (to name just a few). And how are your fantasy rosters holding up? Hang in there; let’s navigate this carnage and move on to Week 7 of the NFL 2026 season. For Week 7, you will be missing the services of quarterbacks Josh Allen, Trevor Lawrence, and Jayden Daniels. Parker Washington, James Cook, and anyone you may have had to roster from the Los Angeles Chargers and Washington Commanders are also not available. So note, there are four teams on a bye this week. The International game will be the Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints; get the studs from that game out of your flex. And remember the “stud” designation refers to fantasypros.com , top-10 fantasy leaders in points. For Week 7, that will be those who led from Weeks1-6. Let’s do this. Pittsburgh Steelers -3.5 v New Orleans Saints, 44.5 This is an International game, being played in Paris, France. Studs: WR4 Chris Olave, TE7 Juwan Johnson, TE8 Pat Friermuth, DST3 Pittsburgh Steelers, LB4 Payton Wilson , DB6 Jalen Ramsey Dud: QB Tyler Shough Could-Be: RB Jaylen Warren PITTSBURGH, PENNSYLVANIA - OCTOBER 11: Jaylen Warren #30 of the Pittsburgh Steelers rushes for a 50 yard touchdown during the third quarter against the Indianapolis Colts(Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images) Getty Images The Why: International games are like divisional games; they are hard to predict. But we know this: Shough is playing with two broken bones in his left hand, and while he is first in pass attempts per game (41.2) and the team is second in pass plays per game (45), last week against the New York Giants (he did have three touchdown passes), he threw for 144 yards; the week prior against the Minnesota Vikings (he did have two interceptions and zero touchdown passes), he threw for 96 yards. This week, he gets the Steelers, who allow the fourth-fewest fantasy points per game to quarterbacks (11.7) and have six interceptions in six weeks while allowing only six touchdown passes. Warren is a beast. While Tampa Bay held him to 50 rushing yards last week, he has a 76.8% opportunity share, a 15.4% target share, and a 57.5% route participation. He averages 5.9 yards per carry and leads the league in yards per touch, at 7.2 per game. And now he will come up against a Saints defense that is allowing the third-most rushing yards per game (138) and the most fantasy points to the running back position (25.7), with 11 rushing touchdowns allowed in six games. Indianapolis Colts @ Minnesota Vikings -6.5, 41.5 The Vikings are coming off their bye week; the Colts are coming off a 20-26 home loss to the Tennessee Titans. Studs: RB5 Jonathan Taylor, DST1 Minnesota Vikings, DL7 DeForest Buckner Dud: QB Daniel Jones Could-Be: QB Kyler Murray The Why: MINNEAPOLIS, MINNESOTA - SEPTEMBER 15: Defensive coordinator Brian Flores of the Minnesota Vikings celebrates after a fourth down stop against the San Francisco 49ers(Photo by Stephen Maturen/Getty Images) Getty Images This is all about the Vikings’ defense. Brian Flores’ defense pressures at approximately 48%; they blitz at approximately 72%. According to Tru Media, they send an extra man to pressure on 66.5% of dropbacks, while averaging 3.4 sacks per game. Add to that, they are allowing a league-low 12.8 points per game. But at times, that ultra-aggressiveness can lead to opponents getting in an explosive play. The Vikings are allowing 4.6 explosive plays per game. They have yielded 12 in the passing game and 11 in the run game. This could bode well for Taylor in the run game. Jones’ outcome doesn’t appear as rosy. Last week he was sacked six times and threw two interceptions, adding to his total of six for the year. Murray will always (when healthy) give us that rushing floor. New York Giants @ Houston Texans -10, 42.5 The Giants have released running back Najee Harris , and J.J. McCarthy made his debut in last week’s loss to the New Orleans Saints. The Texans are returning from their International game win against the Jacksonville Jaguars. Studs: TE1 Isaiah Likely, WR8 Malik Nabers, QB9 C.J. Stroud, DL1 Will Anderson, LB3 Arvell Reese, LB9 Tremaine Edmunds, DB8 Jevon Holland Dud: Giants’ Running Back Room Could-Be: WR Malik Nabers The Why: This is that rare occasion where a stud needs positive reinforcement. The first place NFC East division New York Giants are moving on from quarterback Jameis Winston. They have announced that the recently acquired J.J. McCarthy will be starting this week against the Texans. Some may recall McCarthy’s effect on WR1 Justin Jefferson in Minnesota last season and want to look for other options at wide receiver; that’s valid, but here is why you may want to reconsider. The Texans are currently allowing the second-most fantasy points to the wide receiver position (26.5) while giving up the fifth-most passing yards (246). Since Week 4, Nabers is on the receiving end of a 33.9% target share. That did not stop last week when McCarthy entered the game; 95 of Nabers’ 165 yards (or approximately 56% of Nabers total receiving yards) came when McCarthy entered the game. So while there is still trepidation about McCarthy’s accuracy (52.4% completion percentage last week), the Giants are a condensed offense that currently has no viable run game (Giants average the 10th most rushing attempts per game, 27.8, but are 22nd in rushing yards per attempt, 3.8, while the Texans are allowing the third-fewest rushing yards per game, 83.0), and rely on Nabers volume. Tampa Bay Buccaneers @ Carolina Panthers -3.5, 44.5 Studs: QB10 Bryce Young, LB7 Devin Lloyd, LB8 Josiah Trotter Dud: QB Baker Mayfield Could-Be: WR Jalen Coker CHARLOTTE, NORTH CAROLINA - NOVEMBER 30: Jalen Coker #18 and celebrates a touchdown with Tetairoa McMillan #4(Photo by Grant Halverson/Getty Images) Getty Images The Why: In their last three-week opponents, the Buccaneers have allowed the WR2 or WR1A to at least score a touchdown: Week 4: Green Bay Packers’ Matthew Golden: 7 targets, 3 receptions, 21 yards, 1 touchdown Week 5: Dallas Cowboys’ George Pickens, 13 targets, 9 receptions, 130 yards, 1 touchdown Week 6: Pittsburgh Steelers’ Germie Bernard, 12 targets, 11 receptions, 87 yards, 1 touchdown It’s close, but Coker is slightly behind Tetairoa McMillan in statistical metrics (Coker has also only played four games this season). But Coker is running 67.6% of routes (McMillan 89.1%), Coker has a 24.3% target share (McMillan 26.2%), and a 27.8% first-read share (McMillan 28.3%). San Francisco Niners -2.5 @ Atlanta Falcons, 49.5 Studs: QB2 Brock Purdy, RB3 Bijan Robinson, RB7 Christian McCaffrey, TE3 George Kittle, DST7 Niners, LB5 Fred Warner Dud: RB Kaelon Black Could-Be: QB Michael Penix Jr The Why: This is a hard ask, as the Niners are undefeated and are bringing in a defense that is allowing the ninth-fewest fantasy points to the quarterback position (14.9). But the Falcons are playing at home, Penix is sporting a 64.5% completion percentage for the season, and he is coming off a season-high 33 pass attempts. While having Bijan Robinson is a cheat code, chances are Penix will need to be throwing the ball in catch-up mode once again this week. And last week the Niners did allow Commanders’ quarterback Jayden Daniels to throw for 300 yards and two touchdowns against them. Cleveland Browns -1.5 @ Tennessee Titans, 37.5 The AFC North-leading Browns meet the Titans as they are coming off their win against the Indianapolis Colts last week. Studs: DL4 Jeffery Simmons, LB10 Carson Schwesinger Dud: QB Deshaun Watson Could-Be: Tennessee Titans Defense The Why: This is not a “pick-on” Watson referendum or a holy shinzzel; was I wrong o

item.title: Porro back for Spurs but De Zerbi raises doubts over duo’s involvement against Chelsea
item.description: Porro back for Spurs but De Zerbi raises doubts over duo’s involvement against Chelsea Pedro Porro is back available for Tottenham, but Roberto De Zerbi has raised doubts over the fitness of James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski for the clash with Chelsea. Porro has not played since before the last international break but is in line to feature against Spurs’ rivals. “Pedro is back, Robertson is available, Marmoush is good, Solanke is good,” De Zerbi said. However, De Zerbi confirmed that Lucas Bergvall, Savio and Destiny Udogie remain sidelined this weekend. Maddison, meanwhile, missed the first three days of training this week and De Zerbi is unsure whether he will be ready. “In the first three days Maddison didn’t work with us, so I don’t know if he’s ready for tomorrow,” he said. “We can play with Mathys Tel or Marmoush inside or Gallagher, we have more solutions considering Pedro Porro can play.” Kulusevski is also not yet fully clear, having too not fully trained after returning to action from around a year-and-a-half out on Monday night against Coventry . “Kulusevski worked well but in the first day he stayed individually,” De Zerbi said. The Spurs boss stressed he does not want to take unnecessary risks with players given the number of injuries across football. “Like I said many times, I don’t want to take risks because if you analyse this period of football, you can see many injuries,” he said. “Not for Tottenham, for everyone. If I can, I don’t want to take risks to lose players for many games.” Stay up to date with all the latest Spurs news by joining our Tottenham WhatsApp channel .

item.title: Ian Poulter quits LIV Golf as exodus continues
item.description: Ian Poulter has become the latest high-profile player to exit the floundering LIV Golf circuit. The breakaway league is hoping to avoid Chapter 11 bankruptcy by trying to establish ‘LIV 2.0’ with new investment, following the decision by Saudi Arabia ’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) to cut its funding for the circuit this April. LIV is to make a decision on whether to cease operations or proceed with a scaled-down model this month, with the 25 October deadline for players to confirm their interest in staying on rapidly approaching. Poulter, who co-captained the Majesticks team, has announced he will not be part of the league’s new incarnation. He recently appeared at the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship, his first start at a DP World Tour event in more than three years, while an exit from LIV appeared more likely after he settled fines with the DP World Tour reportedly worth over $1m. The two-time World Golf Championship winner said in a statement: “I wanted everyone to hear it direct from me that I have decided to not move forward with being part of LIV 2.0. Needless to say, it was a tough decision and one I thought about and discussed at length with my family and team. “Ultimately, the opportunity to spend more time at home with my family, reduce international travel, focus on senior golf and have the opportunity to pursue other interests was something that I felt was right for me at this stage of my life and career.” The Englishman conceded that LIV Golf had “divided opinion” but said what he achieved while on the tour “is something I will forever be proud of”, thanking the fans, his teammates and staff for their support. He continued: “I’m looking forward to spending more time with my family, continuing to develop The Postman YouTube channel, sharing more of my life, golf, experiences and competing in some senior events.” The 50-year-old also said he was looking forward to spending more time golfing with sons Luke and Joshua, with the former pursuing a career as a professional. “Having spent so many years travelling the world chasing my own golfing dreams, the opportunity to now spend more time supporting my boys as they chase theirs is something that means a great deal to me,” he said.

item.title: Colts’ DeForest Buckner drops Super Bowl truth bomb as trade rumors heat up
item.description: Bob Donnan-Imagn Images Colts’ DeForest Buckner drops Super Bowl truth bomb as trade rumors heat up appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Indianapolis Colts fired their general manager, Chris Ballard, on Monday, and look set for a lengthy rebuild. Running back Jonathan Taylor has been linked with a trade away from the team, as has defensive lineman DeForest Buckner . Buckner was asked at a press conference how important winning is to him, and he had an emphatic answer . “Obviously, all I care about is winning. My main thing is winning and being able to compete for another Super Bowl.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) In just his fourth season in the league back in 2019, Buckner was fortunate enough to play in the Super Bowl with his old team, the San Francisco 49ers. The Niners lost to the Kansas City Chiefs 31-20 in that game. Unfortunately for Buckner, he has not be anywhere close to reaching that level of competitiveness since being traded to the Colts the following season. After a playoff trip in his first season in 2020, Indy has been mired in mediocrity since. The 32-year-old Buckner is on an expiring contract, so he is a prime candidate to get traded before the deadline. It remains to be seen whether he will get his wish to be on a team that can compete for a Super Bowl. But while he has fallen off from his peak, when he was an All-Pro selection, Buckner has shown he can still contribute to any team that acquires his services. He already has 4.0 sacks and eight quarterback hits in six games this season after getting 4.0 sacks and 13 QB hits in 10 games last year. Related: Jonathan Taylor refuses to do ‘disservice’ to Colts by acknowledging trade buzz Related: Colts rumors: Multiple teams interested in Jonathan Taylor trade, but there’s a catch

item.title: Julian Nagelsmann: Sky Germany reveal huge twist that forces INEOS into quick decision
item.description: Julian Nagelsmann: Sky Germany reveal huge twist that forces INEOS into quick decision If Julian Nagelsmann is the man Ineos want to succeed head coach Michael Carrick , they may need to act without delay. Over the past few weeks, Carrick has failed to demonstrate he has the mettle to bring Premier League glory back to Old Trafford. Performances have remained uninspired, and results have rightly mirrored that. As a result, the Red Devils are now on a seven-match winless run, their longest such streak in a decade. The 4-1 Champions League defeat to Como on Wednesday night ought to have driven the final nail into the coffin of Carrick’s reign at United. Yet he remains in charge for the Premier League clash with Bournemouth this Sunday. However, should United fail to win there, the prevailing belief is that the club will show him the door. Meanwhile, behind the scenes, United are already sounding out potential successors. Sky Germany: Nagelsmann top Man United target but RB Leipzig also keen One coach under active consideration is Julian Nagelsmann. Sky Sports Germany’s Florian Plettenberg has reiterated the links, while issuing a clear warning to Ineos: “We can definitely confirm that Julian Nagelsmann is one of the leading candidates for Manchester United if Michael Carrick has to leave. “He is on the list alongside other candidates, and he is very high up that list. He is available, he has a good reputation in England, and we’ve consistently reported that a move to the Premier League is something he could envisage, particularly if the opportunity came at a top-three or top-four club. And Manchester United are undoubtedly one of the biggest clubs in the world. “To reiterate, RB Leipzig remain in the running. Nothing is concrete yet, and things haven’t heated up, but we absolutely need to keep Manchester United and Julian Nagelsmann on our radar. “And I’ll be completely honest: if the Red Devils make a concrete move for Nagelsmann, I can very much imagine him considering it and perhaps even accepting the offer. He has nothing to lose by taking the Manchester United job; things can only get better there, and the sheer scale and power of Manchester United is enormous.” Leipzig will have Man United on alert While RB Leipzig are by no means in crisis, they sit five points behind Bundesliga leaders Bayern Munich. Heavy back-to-back defeats, 6-1 against Bayern and 4-1 against Real Madrid in their last two matches, have nevertheless planted serious doubts over head coach Martin Demichelis. With Nagelsmann available after leaving the German national team last summer following the World Cup, and given the success he previously enjoyed at the club, Leipzig’s desire to bring him back is entirely understandable. United, for their part, still have a strong chance of securing the ex-Bayern coach ahead of their Bundesliga rivals. But they must move now: in football, circumstances can shift with startling speed, and the opportunity to land a top-class manager coul

item.title: Report: Milan want to bring Athekame back from Lyon loan but face reluctance
item.description: Report: Milan want to bring Athekame back from Lyon loan but face reluctance Reports in Italy claim that Milan have explored the possibility of bringing Zachary Athekame back from his loan spell with Olympique Lyonnais ahead of schedule, but both the French club and the player are not keen on the suggestion according to the latest updates. Report: Milan want Athekame back from Lyon, but club and player say no Athekame joined Lyon on loan for the 2026-27 season back in August, having joined the Rossoneri in a €10m deal from Young Boys the previous summer. His loan to Lyon does not include an option to buy. PISA, ITALY – FEBRUARY 13: Zachary Athekame of AC Milan in action during the Serie A match between Pisa SC and AC Milan at Arena Garibaldi on February 13, 2026 in Pisa, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) He has since gone on to provide two goals and three assists from right-back in his first seven matches in Ligue 1 and according to reports from La Gazzetta dello Sport and Calciomercato.com , the Rossoneri are keen to bring the Switzerland international back from his loan deal in January. This is largely due to concerns regarding Samuel Chukwueze’s latest injury . The Nigerian has started six out of seven Serie A matches at right wing-back under Ruben Amorim so far in 2026-27, but is now facing two to three months on the sidelines with a hamstring injury. According to Calciomercato, Milan representatives have recently been in direct contact with their counterparts in Lyon to discuss the possibility of bringing Athekame back from his loan spell in January. DECINES-CHARPIEU, FRANCE – OCTOBER 15: Zachary Athekame of Olympique Lyonnais reacts to a play during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD2 match between Olympique Lyonnais and Crystal Palace FC at OL Stadium on October 15, 2026 in Decines-Charpieu, France. (Photo by Pauline Figuet/Getty Images) However, both the player and his loan club do not seem convinced by this idea: Athekame has become a key player under Paulo Fonseca and the former Milan coach does not want to lose his first-choice right-back, who has been described as one of the best in France so far this season. Athekame himself is reportedly keen to continue with Lyon, where he has enjoyed an excellent start, and is only interested in returning to Milan once the 2026-27 season is over.

item.title: Vikes Views: Who Ya Got? Indianapolis Colts at Minnesota Vikings
item.description: Vikings vs Colts -- Kelly Holcomb of Indianpolis loose the snap in the 4th quater as Vikings lineman Tony Williams eyes the ball. The fumble was recovered by Jerry Ball of Minnesota.(Photo By JERRY HOLT/Star Tribune via Getty Images) | Star Tribune via Getty Images The Indianapolis Colts head to US Bank Stadium to face the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday. The Vikings are looking healthy coming off a bye and will be excited to continue their undefeated start. The Colts are coming in a little more beat up and they’re having a rough start to the season. Series Record: 9-18-1 Home Record: 9-6-1 Streak: W2 Largest Win: Vikings 52 – Baltimore Colts 14, September 28, 1969 Largest Defeat: Colts 34 – Vikings 6, December 18, 2016 (Adrian Peterson’s last game playing for the Vikings) We always take a moment to enjoy the largest comeback in NFL History that occurred on December 17, 2022. The Vikings came back from a 33-0 deficit against the Matt Ryan led Colts. The Vikings’ 1st ever playoff game came against the Baltimore Colts Decmeber 22, 1968, a 24-14 Colts win. The following year Joe Kapp went off for a NFL tying record 7 TDs in a 52-14 Vikings victory. Andrew Luck’s 1st win was against the Minnesota Vikings in 2012. Daniel Jones has a 0.67 TD to INT ratio for the season. Jonathan Taylor is averaging a career low 4.0 YPC and has yet to record a 100 yard game this season. This is a game the Minnesota Vikings should win. The Colts are giving up a staggering 27.3 points per game vs the Vikings stingy 12.8. Daniel Jones has struggled to find the rythym he had last season. The Colts defense is one of the worst in the league with inexperience throughout the lineup. I can’t see the trends changing, but you never know with the NFL. Minnesota Vikings 20 – Indianapolis Colts 6

item.title: Antonio Conte breaks silence on Juventus and Manchester United links to deny 'baseless' negotiation rumours
item.description: SSC Napoli v Udinese Calcio - Serie A - Getty Images Sport Antonio Conte has taken to social media to directly address the intensifying speculation surrounding his future. The former Napoli boss is currently the subject of heavy interest from Manchester United and Juventus, but he insists that his next move will only be made when the right conditions are met. Conte shuts down talk of imminent return The managerial merry-go-round has been spinning rapidly in recent weeks, with Conte at the very centre of the conversation. Following his successful tenure at Napoli, the Italian tactician has been widely touted as the primary candidate to take over at Man Utd , where Michael Carrick is under immense pressure, or return to Juventus should the club part ways with Luciano Spalletti. However, Conte has now moved to dismiss claims that a deal with any new employer is close to being finalised. In a detailed statement shared across his social media platforms, the former Chelsea and Inter manager made it clear that he is in no rush to step back into the dugout. "My name has been linked with numerous clubs, but at present there are no negotiations at an advanced stage,” reads the statement released by the coach, as quoted by La Gazzetta dello Sport . "Following a wonderful and successful spell in charge of Napoli, I will take the time needed to assess how and when to return to management. It will be a measured choice, which I will make when I believe the right conditions are in place. Dismissing rumours of financial demands Beyond the simple links to Old Trafford and Turin, several reports had suggested that Conte was making significant financial demands and seeking total control over recruitment. Some outlets claimed his "strong character" was proving to be a stumbling block in negotiations with certain hierarchies. Conte was quick to label these specific details as complete fabrications, noting that since no deep talks have occurred, any discussion regarding his salary or personality is premature. The manager was firm in his stance that his professional reputation is being unfairly categorised by speculative reports. "I have read about alleged financial demands and requests for full powers that I have supposedly already put forward to the clubs mentioned, as well as reservations linked to what is described as my ‘strong character’. These are baseless accounts because, as things stand, there are no concrete elements on which to base such assessments," Conte added. The criteria for a potential agreement Conte’s message also served as a blueprint for how he intends to handle future discussions. He suggested that any talk of terms would only happen once a formal project is presented to him. He remains open to the right opportunity but insists on a mutual respect between the coach and the club's board. item.content:encoded: SSC Napoli v Udinese Calcio - Serie A - Getty Images Sport Antonio Conte has taken to social media to directly address the intensifying speculation surrounding his future. The former Napoli boss is currently the subject of heavy interest from Manchester United and Juventus, but he insists that his next move will only be made when the right conditions are met. Conte shuts down talk of imminent return The managerial merry-go-round has been spinning rapidly in recent weeks, with Conte at the very centre of the conversation. Following his successful tenure at Napoli, the Italian tactician has been widely touted as the primary candidate to take over at Man Utd , where Michael Carrick is under immense pressure, or return to Juventus should the club part ways with Luciano Spalletti. However, Conte has now moved to dismiss claims that a deal with any new employer is close to being finalised. In a detailed statement shared across his social media platforms, the former Chelsea and Inter manager made it clear that he is in no rush to step back into the dugout. "My name has been linked with numerous clubs, but at present there are no negotiations at an advanced stage,” reads the statement released by the coach, as quoted by La Gazzetta dello Sport . "Following a wonderful and successful spell in charge of Napoli, I will take the time needed to assess how and when to return to management. It will be a measured choice, which I will make when I believe the right conditions are in place. Dismissing rumours of financial demands Beyond the simple links to Old Trafford and Turin, several reports had suggested that Conte was making significant financial demands and seeking total control over recruitment. Some outlets claimed his "strong character" was proving to be a stumbling block in negotiations with certain hierarchies. Conte was quick to label these specific details as complete fabrications, noting that since no deep talks have occurred, any discussion regarding his salary or personality is premature. The manager was firm in his stance that his professional reputation is being unfairly categorised by speculative reports. "I have read about alleged financial demands and requests for full powers that I have supposedly already put forward to the clubs mentioned, as well as reservations linked to what is described as my ‘strong character’. These are baseless accounts because, as things stand, there are no concrete elements on which to base such assessments," Conte added. The criteria for a potential agreement Conte’s message also served as a blueprint for how he intends to handle future discussions. He suggested that any talk of terms would only happen once a formal project is presented to him. He remains open to the right opportunity but insists on a mutual respect between the coach and the club's board. By setting these boundaries publicly, he has regained control of the narrative surrounding his career path following his departure from the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona. "Should a concrete opportunity arise, that will be the moment to speak with the club in question and evaluate together the terms of any potential agreement, respecting each other's needs and the characteristics that define my work as a coach," the Italian clarified. "Until then, any hypothesis regarding my demands and my professional future remains purely speculative and cannot be regarded as fact." A high-stakes waiting game The timing of the statement is particularly interesting given the crisis currently unfolding at Man Utd. The Red Devils suffered a humiliating defeat against Como, leading to intense scrutiny of Carrick’s position. While the United board has offered temporary backing to their current manager, the shadow of Conte continues to loom large over the Premier League giants. Similarly, Juventus are monitoring the market closely as they look to re-establish themselves as the dominant force in Serie A. For now, the football world must wait. Whether it is a return to the Allianz Stadium or a move to the Theatre of Dreams, Conte has ensured that any future appointment will happen on his terms and his timeline alone, effectively putting all interested parties on notice.

item.title: Red Wings Hit With Another Injury During Win Over Canucks
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings extended their point streak to six games with a 5-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night, but the celebration came with an unexpected concern. Starting goaltender John Gibson suffered an upper-body injury and did not return for the third period, leaving Detroit with uncertainty surrounding both of its regular NHL goaltenders. Gibson’s departure came just hours after the Red Wings recalled Michal Postava from the Grand Rapids Griffins under emergency conditions because backup goaltender Daniil Tarasov was already dealing with an injury. That meant Postava, who had never appeared in an NHL game, suddenly found himself protecting Detroit’s lead in Vancouver. Oct 10, 2026; Montreal, Quebec, CAN; Detroit Red Wings goalie John Gibson (36) looks on during warm-up before the game against the Montreal Canadiens at Bell Centre. Mandatory Credit: David Kirouac-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) John Gibson Exits Red Wings Victory With Injury Gibson started Thursday’s game and stopped four of the five shots he faced through the first two periods. Detroit dominated much of the action, including a remarkable second period in which the Canucks failed to register a single shot on goal. However, Gibson did not return to the crease for the final 20 minutes. The Red Wings initially described the issue as an upper-body injury, but head coach Todd McLellan provided additional information afterward. According to the team’s official postgame update , McLellan explained that Gibson was dealing with an issue involving his eye. “He had something in his eye. They’re still looking at it,” McLellan said. The coach also indicated that he learned about the situation late in the second intermission, leaving Detroit little time to prepare for a goaltending change. The extent of Gibson’s injury and his availability for Saturday’s game against Calgary have not yet been determined. Michal Postava Makes Unexpected NHL Debut The timing of Gibson’s departure was particularly unusual because Detroit had already experienced another goaltending injury earlier in the week. As we previously reported following Thursday’s emergency roster moves , the Red Wings recalled Postava from Grand Rapids after Tarasov developed an undisclosed injury. McLellan later explained that Tarasov had aggravated something during Wednesday’s practice, prompting the organization to bring in additional insurance. That decision became extremely important just one day later. item.content:encoded: The Detroit Red Wings extended their point streak to six games with a 5-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night, but the celebration came with an unexpected concern.
